title: A pest trumpet player in a red tux
summary: A bad trumpeter in a red tux used to heckle Roy in New York.

story.theme_name: Band pranks, jokes and gigs gone wrong
story.community_name: Pranks, practical jokes and band humor

blocks.x: There used to be a cat around here called... They used to call him the Deacon or something. I don't know what the hell they used to call him. Not the one that was real known, not the good one. But this cat used to wear, like, an Ambassador, a red tux all the way with the sash. And he was the worst trumpet player! He used to follow me home: "You ain't playin' shit!" Ha-ha-ha. I wouldn't (?), I stayed with (?), you know. "Come on out!" Heh-heh... I wouldn't let it affect me.
Strange cats around there in those days. Very funny.
